evidence.quote: Seward representing the Administration in the Senate took the lead; Mr.
Rightly or wrongly the new President and his chief advisers decided that
He was thunderstruck to learn that Senator Sumner privately denounced the course

adjudications.reason: In the revision, the concession policy belongs only to 'the new President and his chief advisers'. Nothing now states that Mr. Adams led the House on this course. Sumner later denounces 'the course' and Mr. Adams as betraying his principles, so that denunciation loses its stated basis. The secretary's limited-knowledge irony ('as far as a private secretary knew, the party united') is what 'thunderstruck' pays off. The surviving 'made their speeches' only hints at Mr. Adams's role.

evidence.quote: no one could tell which was the mask and which the features
had the youth of his sympathies. What was more unusual

adjudications.reason: Every element the plan marks essential survives: the macaw head and cigar, mask versus features, 'Henry Adams thought it charming', and the effect of unselfishness. 'What was more unusual' still reads naturally after 'the youth of his sympathies'. The further trait list is a legitimate compression tradeoff, not a broken function.

evidence.quote: Many a shock was Henry Adams to meet in the course of a long life
never exchanged a word with Mr. Sumner on the subject, then or afterwards

adjudications.reason: Retrospective distance around the rupture is still present. 'Many a shock was Henry Adams to meet in the course of a long life' supplies it, as do 'as long as life lasted' and 'then or afterwards'. The 'would have lost' admission also frames the young man's misjudgments. Paragraph 22 reads coherently after 'there it ended'. This is an artistic tradeoff.

replacements.new: depended on the action of Virginia. Governor Seward took the lead in the Senate; Mr. Adams took the lead in the House; and as far as a private secretary knew, the party united on its tactics.
replacements.old: depended on the action of Virginia.
replacements.reason: Restore the source-backed sentence that grounds Sumner's denunciation of Mr. Adams's course and the secretary's ironic belief in party unity.

replacements.old: The young man was beyond satire, and asked only a pretext for throwing all education to the east wind.
replacements.reason: Optional cut to offset the restoration. The father's ironic hint and the secretaryship remain intact.
